profile.visual_desc: Massive human male in spiked grey heavy armor, blue tunic, and red sash. He carries a large curved battle axe, a heavy dark shield, and has thick brown hair.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Intense profile facing left, featuring a fierce glare, thick brown eyebrows, and a massive bushy brown beard and mustache. A grey pauldron with a blue gem is visible.
profile.weapon_desc: Large curved battle axe in the right hand, heavy dark shield on the left arm.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric stance facing up-left. Shield guarded on the left arm, right hand holding the axe high behind the head.
profile.step2_windup: The body compresses slightly, pulling the axe to its maximum backward height to build momentum.
profile.step3_impact: A powerful downward sweeping slash. A large, thick pale-yellow energy arc perfectly traces the axe blade's curved trajectory from top-right to bottom-left.
profile.step4_finish: The axe follows through low to the ground while the golden slash trail quickly dissipates, followed by a return to a resting guard stance.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The pale-yellow energy arc in Frame 4 must perfectly follow the downward curved path of the axe blade.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation maintains stable perspective and biomechanical consistency. VFX arc and frame sequencing align with reference standards.
